Architecture¶

Django project¶

news_project contains the settings, root URL configuration, and WSGI/ASGI entry points. manage.py is the command-line entry point. The news app contains the newsroom domain, browser pages, API, role checks, and signals.

Core data¶

  • User extends Django’s user model with Reader, Journalist, and Editor roles.

  • Publisher groups journalists and editors and can have reader subscribers.

  • Article belongs to exactly one journalist or publisher and is hidden from general feeds until an editor approves it.

  • Newsletter groups approved articles under a journalist’s account.

  • ApprovedArticleLog stores an audit record from the internal integration.

Approval flow¶

Editors approve articles from the review page or API. A model signal detects the transition to approved, emails eligible subscribers, and posts the article ID to the internal approval endpoint. The endpoint checks a shared secret and creates an idempotent log entry. Email and API integrations use safe local defaults; production deployments should use HTTPS and private secrets.
